title: Microsoft Purview DSPM: Copilot readiness and data explorer
summary: The roadmap details and both documented administration paths check out; the gaps about the new experiences are appropriately qualified. The claim that oversharing is the usual reason Copilot deployments stall is unsupported, and the checklist's access controls need table rows.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft pauses background Microsoft 365 data refresh in DSPM after more than 60 days without tenant access.

claims.claim: Oversharing is the usual reason a Copilot rollout stalls.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot oversharing most common reason deployment stalls. Read DSPM Oversharing and Secure and govern Microsoft Copilot: Foundational deployment guidance excerpts; they establish an oversharing risk, not the usual cause of stalled deployments.
claims.fix: Replace 'Oversharing is the usual reason a Copilot rollout stalls' with 'Oversharing is a risk to address before a Copilot rollout', supported by https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/data-security-posture-management-oversharing.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not say whether the readiness experience replaces or updates an existing page.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to review DSPM roles, but the controls table has no role-based-access row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Compare the people who will use these views with the DSPM role lists in Learn'. Table rows: tenant-wide switch; oversharing findings and remediation; sensitive-data investigation.
claims.fix: Add a row for existing DSPM role-based access, using https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/data-security-posture-management-permissions. Research each UI/API side and retain the qualification that roles specific to the two new views are not documented.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to check administrative-unit scoping, but the controls table has no administrative-unit row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'check whether results respect administrative units'. Table rows: tenant-wide switch; oversharing findings and remediation; sensitive-data investigation.
claims.fix: Add a row for existing administrative-unit scoping, using https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/data-security-posture-management-considerations#support-for-administrative-units-in-data-security-posture-management. Research its UI/API sides and state that applicability to the two new views is not documented.
